leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a service class with the @Injectable decorator to encapsulate data logic
Configure HTTP client methods to fetch data from external APIs
Construct observable streams to handle asynchronous data operations
Integrate the data service into components through dependency injection
Apply error handling mechanisms for failed data requests
Manipulate retrieved data using RxJS operators before displaying in templates
Initialize service subscriptions within component lifecycle hooks
